The subagent is the only extension whose `schema.ts` imports RUNTIME values (`StringEnum`, `Type`) from the pi SDK's typebox — at runtime pi's extension loader aliases the legacy `@mariozechner/pi-ai` to the bundled `@earendil-works/pi-ai`, but plain `tsx` (used by scripts/run-tests.mjs) cannot resolve it (the SDK lives nested under pi-coding-agent's node_modules, never hoisted). These paths point tsx at that same bundled copy so the schema test resolves a SINGLE TypeBox/pi-ai instance (no dual-instance symbol split). They do NOT affect production: pi's loader ignores this tsconfig. Passed to tsx via `--tsconfig` in run-tests.mjs (subagent package).
